verbatim_quote: Commissioner Garcia Richard Again Denies Request to Run Portion of Project Jupiter Pipeline Through State Lands... citing environmental and water resource conservation concerns.
Oracle confirms anchor tenancy for Project Jupiter in Santa Teresa, New Mexico, announcing an updated behind-the-meter energy architecture utilizing up to 2.45 GW of Bloom Energy fuel cells.

As of May 31, 2026, our unconditional purchase and certain other obligations, which were primarily related to data center power arrangements, were as follows (in millions): Fiscal 2027: $1,841 ... Total: $13,309 ... Subsequent to May 31, 2026, we entered into an additional $19 billion of unconditional purchase commitments for cloud infrastructure assets.
Oracle's $18 billion data center debt under pressure... loans for the Project Jupiter development trading at 89-91 cents on the dollar amid syndication hurdles and power availability concerns.

Doña Ana County Board of County Commissioners approves industrial revenue bond framework and property authorization for the Project Jupiter hyperscale data center campus in Santa Teresa across 1,400 acres.
